title: El castillo: las dos puertas cerradas
description: docs/castle.md § The closed doors. The closed room in the middle of the second floor (El horario: the door, the board, the sheet on screen, wrong and then squared) and of the third (Pica pared: the great Castigado counting, looking, catching whoever walks, and the wall reached while it counts). Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Second floor, the closed room: her gum over the door on, the office's seal on it, and the timetable's board on the side wall under its own lamp
The door says why it will not open, and whose job that is
The first look at the sheet: Gerard says what a timetable is
The sheet on screen: what is in ink stays, the rest is pencilled in. It squares one way only, another each day

steps.eval: (() => { const { horario } = window.gerard.story.horario; const cell = i => document.querySelector('.horario-cell[data-cell="' + i + '"]'); window.put = (i, want) => { if (!cell(i).hasAttribute('aria-current')) cell(i).click(); for (let k = 0; k < 6 && cell(i) && Number(cell(i).dataset.subject ?? 0) !== want; k++) cell(i).click(); }; const open = horario.given.map((v, i) => v ? -1 : i).filter(i => i >= 0); window.__last = open[0]; window.put(open[0], (horario.solution[open[0]] % 4) + 1); for (const i of open.slice(1)) window.put(i, horario.solution[i]); })()

steps.caption: Full but wrong: «No cuadra.» It never says where
It squares: the seal lets go
The way on, open for good, and an Eco de luz for the jar
Third floor: a great Castigado against the door on, face to the wall, counting
It turns round with no more warning than its shoulders: the room lights up under its look
Seen moving: pulled back to the door they came in by. Aitor says what he saw, once
Walking only while it counts, to the wall beside it: it stops counting
It slides down the door and the gum lets go: the way on, open for good
